items.docs:
This endpoint is now `Obsolete`. Use the [Create Campaign Requests](#operation/createCampaignRequests) endpoint instead.

Request access to one or more Campaigns. If a Campaign has any custom Terms and Conditions then the Partner must agree to these terms when requesting access. This is achieved by passing the latest `terms_id` from the relevant Campaign object. On certain Campaigns, you may find that a Partner will be auto-approved.
